sentence_stem: Although the authors presented convincing data,
correct_completion: other researchers later questioned the study's methodology.
full_sentence: Although the authors presented convincing data, other researchers later questioned the study's methodology.
acceptable_variants: some reviewers still doubted the conclusions.

options.text: because the sample size was very large.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, but 'although' requires a contrast with the convincing data.

options.text: so the findings were accepted without any debate.
options.why_wrong: This continues in the same direction as the convincing data instead of contrasting with it.

options.text: other researchers later questioned the study's methodology.
the data was therefore collected twice.
options.why_wrong: 'Therefore' introduces a consequence, and this option does not create a contrast with the evidence.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must express a contrast with the first clause. Learners often choose a result or cause clause here, but a concessive connector needs an opposing idea.
